{
  "claims": [
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:62541",
      "quote": "On B200, DSpark verifies the full 5-token block (`enable_adaptive_verification:false`)",
      "claim": "Author claim: the qualified B200 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lanes use fixed DSpark k5.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "B200 recipe presets described in an open documentation PR.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports a qualifying sweep, but no B200 comparison of fixed and adaptive verification.",
      "transfer_inference": "Use fixed k5 as the reference configuration for any B200 frontier test.",
      "limitations": "The PR changes guide text; an adaptive-verification effect size on B200 is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:59970",
      "quote": "adaptive verification **on**, `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` | IMA within 1 min at c96 (4/4)",
      "claim": "Observed report: adaptive verification with mixed prefill and decode in FULL graphs triggered illegal memory access.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "2× B300, TP2, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, FlashInfer sparse attention, high-concurrency chat load.",
      "reported_result": "The reporter reproduced the failure four times in four attempts.",
      "transfer_inference": "A B200 adaptive-verification trial needs a graph-safety gate for mixed batches before performance calibration.",
      "limitations": "This is a B300 report. Whether the same failure occurs on B200 is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:59970",
      "quote": "adaptive verification **on**, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` | stable: 15 min at c128",
      "claim": "Observed report: restricting FULL graphs to decode avoided the reported failure during a shorter run.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "Same B300 issue and load family; adaptive verification remained enabled.",
      "reported_result": "The reported arm ran for 15 minutes at c128 without the stated failure.",
      "transfer_inference": "Decode-only FULL capture is a candidate safety condition for a B200 adaptive-verification experiment.",
      "limitations": "A 15-minute stable run does not establish long-run safety, B200 safety, or throughput benefit."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:59986",
      "quote": "Downgrade them to `UNIFORM_BATCH` and report the speculation width as the varlen decode bound",
      "claim": "Author claim: limiting DSV4.1 sparse builders to uniform FULL-graph batches could keep prefill and mixed batches out of unsafe capture.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "Open PR covering five DSV4.1-specific metadata builders.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports 82 CPU tests passed; the B300 end-to-end reproducer was not run.",
      "transfer_inference": "This is a concrete graph-eligibility change to validate before enabling adaptive verification on the B200 lane.",
      "limitations": "Runtime safety on B200 and any performance effect are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:54046",
      "quote": "Anything the profiler measures above 1024 tokens cannot be decode.",
      "claim": "Observed bug analysis: adaptive-verification cost profiling can construct a uniform decode shape that the scheduler cannot produce.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Reported on 2× B200 with max_num_seqs=128 and seven speculative tokens.",
      "reported_result": "The issue identifies an invalid profiling shape; it does not report a B200 performance comparison.",
      "transfer_inference": "Calibrate verification cost using scheduler-reachable shapes, including mixed prefill and decode tails above the decode ceiling. Recompute that ceiling for k5 and the chosen sequence limit.",
      "limitations": "The example uses k7, and its B200 cost or effect size is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:54077",
      "quote": "This change profiles tail samples as schedulable mixed decode/prefill batches.",
      "claim": "Author claim: the proposed profiling change supplies realistic mixed-batch shapes for adaptive-verification cost calibration.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "Open PR; regression tests ran on an RTX 5090.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports 54 tests passed and says a full DSpark serving evaluation was not run.",
      "transfer_inference": "A B200 calibration should preserve captured graph shapes and use explicit, schedulable request splits for tail samples.",
      "limitations": "The tests establish the reported shape behavior, not B200 serving benefit; effect size is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2605.00342",
      "quote": "runtime conditions and domain shift may still affect their accuracy",
      "claim": "Author limitation: estimates of verification cost and acceptance benefit may become inaccurate when serving conditions change.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "EVICT paper excerpt concerning adaptive verification for MoE speculative decoding.",
      "reported_result": "The supplied passage states a limitation; its implementation details, hardware, workload, and relevant effect size are unknown from the excerpt.",
      "transfer_inference": "If using a cost-based selection policy, calibrate and check it across B200 concurrency, prefill mix, and acceptance regimes.",
      "limitations": "The supplied full text has excerpt gaps. This passage is not evidence that the method is implemented in the B200 DSpark lane."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:52783",
      "quote": "It was validated end to end with `nvidia/GLM-5.2-NVFP4` and `RedHatAI/GLM-5.2-speculator.dspark` on 4× NVIDIA B300.",
      "claim": "Author report: adaptive DSpark ran end to end with a sparse-MLA backend on B300.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "GLM-5.2, separate speculator, k7, four B300 GPUs.",
      "reported_result": "The PR reports successful serving and evaluation requests; no result is asserted here for B200.",
      "transfer_inference": "This supports technical plausibility only. Verify the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backend, graph handling, and acceptance behavior separately on B200.",
      "limitations": "Model, drafter, hardware, and k differ from the fixed B200 DeepSeek k5 lane; B200 effect size is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:45963",
      "quote": "With DP, ranks can choose different K values, and the EAGLE/draft proposer has K-dependent DP collectives.",
      "claim": "Author claim: rank-local dynamic speculative depth can cause inconsistent collective participation under data parallelism.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Merged PR concerning `num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size` with data_parallel_size > 1.",
      "reported_result": "The change falls back to static k under DP; no B200 verification benefit is reported.",
      "transfer_inference": "Do not equate adaptive verification with changing draft k. Any B200 policy that changes k across DP ranks needs coordinated choices or a static-k fallback.",
      "limitations": "The cited failure mode concerns dynamic draft depth, not proof that adaptive verification itself has this problem."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2609.37532",
      "quote": "On A100 with TP1, two target models, four datasets, and concurrency 8–32",
      "claim": "Author report: DScale evaluates a different adaptive verification design in an A100 setting.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "Block-diffusion speculative decoding, A100 TP1, concurrency 8–32.",
      "reported_result": "The excerpt describes the evaluation setting; no B200 result is supplied.",
      "transfer_inference": "Its mechanism may motivate candidate policies, but it cannot establish a gain for B200 DSpark k5.",
      "limitations": "Different algorithm, hardware, models, and concurrency range; B200 effect size is unknown."
    }
  ],
  "unanswered": [
    "Does adaptive verification pass sustained mixed-prefill and decode safety tests on the exact B200 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backend and graph mode?",
    "Are schedulable mixed-batch calibration shapes and the relevant graph-safety changes present in the B200 serving build?",
    "What are verification cost and acceptance behavior across the actual B200 workload, concurrency, and prefill mix?",
    "Does a safely enabled adaptive-verification policy improve any B200 throughput or latency frontier point against fixed DSpark k5? The supplied sources do not measure this."
  ]
}
